awards.display_name: PURPOSE: THE PURPOSE OF THIS PROPOSAL IS TO ESTABLISH A STANDARDS DEVELOPMENT CENTER FOR AUTOMATED DRIVING SYSTEMS (ADS) AT MICHIGAN TECHNOLOGICAL UNIVERSITY (MTU) TO SUPPORT STANDARD DEVELOPMENT ORGANIZATIONS, MANUFACTURERS, AND GOVERNMENT AGENCIES IN THE PERFORMANCE TESTING OF ADS IN INCLEMENT WINTER WEATHER. THIS CENTER AIMS TO ADDRESS THE LACK OF TEST METHODS FOR ADS TECHNOLOGY UNDER INCLEMENT WINTER CONDITIONS, WHICH IS NECESSARY TO ENSURE QUALITY, SAFETY, AND PUBLIC TRUST IN AUTOMATED DRIVING. THE PROJECT INVOLVES OFF-VEHICLE COMPONENT-LEVEL TESTING, DATA COLLECTION FROM ADS-EQUIPPED VEHICLES, AND THE VALIDATION OF MACHINE LEARNING ML) MODELS TO DEMONSTRATE THE EFFECTS OF WINTER WEATHER ON ADS PERFORMANCE. ACTIVITIES TO BE PERFORMED: SIX MAIN ACTIVITIES ARE IDENTIFIED IN THE DOCUMENT:1. OFF-VEHICLE COMPONENT-LEVEL TESTING: THIS ACTIVITY CONSISTS OF CONDUCTING TESTS ON VARIOUS ADS TECHNOLOGIESSUCH AS LIDAR, OPTICAL CAMERAS, RADAR, INFRARED CAMERAS, AND V2I COMMUNICATION IN INCLEMENT WINTER WEATHER. THE ACTIVITY ALSO CONSISTS OF BENCHMARKING OFF-VEHICLE COMPONENTS WITH STATIONARY CALIBRATION TARGETS UNDER STANDARD AND INCLEMENT WINTER WEATHER CONDITIONS TO EVALUATE THEIR PERFORMANCE AND DETERIORATION. 2. ADS-EQUIPPED VEHICLE DATA COLLECTION: COLLECT DRIVING DATASETS FROM MTU?S EXISTING ADS-EQUIPPED VEHICLE FLEET IN REAL-WORLD INCLEMENT WINTER WEATHER CONDITIONS AND GATHER MULTIMODAL DATA FROM LIDAR, OPTICAL CAMERAS, INFRARED CAMERAS, RADAR, V2I, AND CAN BUS SYSTEMS. 3. VALIDATION OF DATASETS THROUGH MACHINE LEARNING MODELS: IN A FIRST STEP, ANNOTATE THE COLLECTED DATASETS AND TRAIN STATE-OF-THE-ART MACHINE LEARNING MODELS ON THE DATA. IN THE SECOND STEP, VALIDATE THE IMPACT OF INCLEMENT WINTER WEATHER ON THESE MODELS WITH FOCUS ON OBJECT DETECTION AND SENSOR FUSION CAPABILITIES. 4. DEMONSTRATION OF ELEMENTAL BEHAVIORAL COMPETENCY: DEMONSTRATE A SPECIFIC AUTOMATED DRIVING FUNCTIONALITY (ELEMENTAL BEHAVIORAL COMPETENCY) OF RESPONDING TO A LANE OBSTRUCTION IN INCLEMENT WINTER WEATHER. 5. DEVELOPMENT OF AN ADS STANDARDS PLAYBOOK: CREATE A PLAYBOOK TO CONSOLIDATE VARIOUS ADS STANDARDS ANDFRAMEWORKS, INCLUDING OPERATIONAL DESIGN DOMAINS (ODDS), SENSOR TECHNOLOGIES, COMMUNICATION, AND CYBERSECURITY. 6. STAKEHOLDER ENGAGEMENT AND AWARENESS EVENT: HOST AN ADS IN INCLEMENT WINTER WEATHER AWARENESS EVENT TO DEMONSTRATE THE PROJECT?S FINDINGS AND PROMOTE THE STANDARDS PLAYBOOK. ENGAGE WITH GOVERNMENT AGENCIES, INDUSTRY STAKEHOLDERS, AND STANDARD DEVELOPMENT ORGANIZATIONS (SDOS) TO BUILD SUPPORT FOR THE CENTER AND ITS OBJECTIVES.EXPECTED OUTCOMES:THE EXPECTED OUTCOMES OF THIS PROJECT INCLUDE THE CREATION OF A SPECIALIZED CENTER AT MICHIGAN TECHNOLOGICAL UNIVERSITY DEDICATED TO TESTING AUTOMATED DRIVING SYSTEMS (ADS) IN INCLEMENT WINTER WEATHER. THIS CENTER WILL DEVELOP AND VALIDATE NEW TEST METHODS AND DATASETS FOR ADS COMPONENTS AND SYSTEMS TO ENHANCE THEIR PERFORMANCE AND RELIABILITY UNDER CHALLENGING (INCLEMENT) WEATHER CONDITIONS. THE PROJECT WILL PRODUCE A COMPREHENSIVE PLAYBOOK CONSOLIDATING ADS TESTING STANDARDS, FACILITATE STAKEHOLDER ENGAGEMENT THROUGH AN AWARENESS EVENT, AND PROMOTE EDUCATIONAL AWARENESS IN ADS TESTING.
